title: Hamilton and Parallel Fluidics partner to automate advanced workflows on liquid handlers
summary: Hamilton's press-release page lists a partnership with Parallel Fluidics, a Boston microfluidic-consumables maker, to automate advanced lab workflows on Hamilton liquid handlers. Only the headline was retrievable; terms are not visible.

claims.text: Hamilton press page lists the partnership, dated 5 Nov 2026

why_it_matters: Consumable-level integrations widen what a standard liquid handler can run; terms unseen, and LNP work is more biologics than core ADME.
query: Hamilton automated liquid handling news November 2026

title: PyLabRobot week: STAR/Prep probing offsets, VANTAstar simulation, animated 3D visualizer
summary: PyLabRobot merged PRs since 2 Nov: STAR and Prep pipettes get probe offsets and renamed offsets/jets arguments, the VANTAstar reader gains simulation, and the 3D visualizer animates joint moves.

claims.text: #1592 renames resource_offsets/jet to offsets/jets on aspirate/dispense (old names deprecated); #1595 adds offsets to probe methods
STAR dispense: blow-out mode follows the blow-out air volume (#1593)
v1 VANTAstar: simulation=True and setup against a saved declared configuration (#1585, #1584)
Visualizer3D: an animated move turns a part about its joint (#1591)
Tip-rack definitions are now always built; official_tip_rack_identity removed (#1453, mostly Opentrons racks)

why_it_matters: Simulation-first drivers let scripts, and any AI-written ones, be tested before touching hardware; a recurring pattern in this repo.
